data.description: 握手会会场里，星野爱隔着桌面握住粉丝的手，星形瞳孔亮得像两颗真正的星星，双色裙装在会馆灯光下泛着柔光——「谢谢你今天来见我……我最喜欢你了。」
data.promptProse: At the fan meeting, Ai sits at the left of the table in her pink-and-white stage dress, her purple hair and starry eyes catching the lamp. A fan with a short chestnut bob, round glasses and a sage-green cardigan reaches from the right. They meet each other's gaze while clasping hands across the table.
data.title: 星野爱 · 握手会
data.animaCaption: Ai sits on the left in her pink stage dress, with long purple hair and star pupils. Across the table, the fan has a short chestnut bob, round glasses and a sage-green cardigan. Both faces are visible as they shake hands.
